content.scenario: The Central Government appoints a President and members to the National Commission. The rules specify a term of office not exceeding five years.
content.outcome: The President and members of the National Commission shall hold office for a term not exceeding five years from the date they enter upon their office and are eligible for re-appointment.

user_queries: What is the term of office for the President and members of the National Commission?
Can the President and members be re-appointed?
What are the conditions for re-appointment?
